audit_items.proof_trace: `verifyCodeChallenge` (L52-54) unconditionally returns `false` for any `method !== 'S256'` before performing any crypto, and the token endpoint (token/route.ts:110-114) calls it on every authorization_code grant with no bypass path. Although `code_challenge_method` transits through an unvalidated hidden form field in the consent flow (consent-form.tsx:58), tampering it to any non-S256 value only causes the downstream `verifyCodeChallenge` call to return `false`, blocking token issuance — the attacker cannot obtain a token via the plain method.
